# Exercise metadata

Source: https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db at a859101d633a01c4a1a920d6a8ce41dabba0705f. License: Unlicense (commercial use permitted; see LICENSE.md). Only names and taxonomy are vendored; images and instructions are excluded. FitLive adds stable prefixed IDs, display-group mappings and configurable strength defaults. Unknown equipment is labeled unknown, not inferred. Defaults are UI starting settings, not individualized prescriptions.
